nccl.source_behavior: The extended-IPv4 and PCI-domain options are enabled independently of switchless-ring mode. In the pinned patch, ncclIbListen publishes extended GIDs only inside the subnet-aware gate; ncclIbConnectImpl calls ncclIbFindDevBySubnet only inside that same gate. PCI-root preference is inside ncclIbFindDevBySubnet and retains an already reachable default device. With NCCL_IB_SUBNET_AWARE_ROUTING=0, those advertisement/preference paths are inactive and ordinary L2 topology-selected HCA connections remain unchanged. NCCL_SWITCHLESS_RING_ONLY=0 does not suppress tree/PAT setup.
nccl.required_library_identity: Use runtime.nccl_path and runtime.nccl_sha256 from the exact common source lock for the built image.

source_findings.finding: PyNcclCommunicator is constructed for world_size > 1. With custom all-reduce, B12X PCIe/RoCE, FlashInfer, and symmetric memory disabled, all_reduce reaches pynccl_comm.all_reduce, and ordinary all_gather/reduce_scatter use PyNccl.

PrefillOwnership uses the enabled TP PyNccl communicator directly, independently of RoCEnante. It owns BF16 row shards and invokes NCCL reduce-scatter/all-gather; TP4/DCP1 is admitted. Startup checks and capability votes reject an unavailable communicator.

The common validator admits TP4/DCP1 with the V2 runner, BF16 GLM5Next, B12X KDA, 8192-token chunks, aligned prefix caching, retention interval 0, and static MTP3. It imposes no physical ring or custom-transport requirement.

required_image_integration.dispatch_contract: Use the existing generic warmup wrapper after common verification. The initially empty PYTHONPATH permits the wrapper to add only /opt/sparkring/bin for startup admission; no ring/mesh hook directory is added.

operator_requirements: Provide exact HCA names/ports that are physically connected to the switch on each rank, plus the correct GID and bootstrap interfaces.
An HCA function count does not identify the number of physical uplinks. No one-uplink or two-uplink layout is assumed.
Configure and verify the switch, RoCE links, MTU and peer reachability independently; the launcher does not change host or switch networking.
qualification_requirements: Verify built image source/file witnesses against the exact source lock and this profile hash.
Complete bounded shape warmup and all six generic sampler request recipes before rank-zero readiness.
Keep SparkCache disabled in this profile.
limitations: Switched deployments are provided as-is. This profile has not been validated on switched hardware.
